tasks.short: After each pay run, make the period reports and match the Rabobank payments to what AFAS says we paid.

today.trigger: Monthly pay run closed in AFAS and the Rabobank SEPA batch has been executed
steps: Export the pay run journal and net pay list from AFAS Profit to Excel
Download the Rabobank statement and find the salary batch and any rejected payments
Match net pay per employee and totals for wage tax, pension and agency lines
Chase differences (returned payments, manual payments, advances) by mail
Build the period-end report pack and send it to the Controller
drudgery: Copying exports into the same Excel template every month
today.time_sinks: Hunting the few unmatched items (returned IBANs, off-cycle payments) in a long list

lenses.faster: A matching script reads the AFAS payment file and the Rabobank camt.053 statement and matches on IBAN, amount and reference; the specialist only sees the unmatched lines.
lenses.autonomous: The match runs when the statement for the payment date arrives and posts a one-page result to the Controller, with exceptions routed to payroll.
lenses.ambitious: Reconcile every off-cycle payment and every week, not only the monthly batch, so returned or double payments are caught within a day.
lenses.joy: Nobody misses ticking off 1,200 lines; what is left is solving the three real anomalies.
lenses.options: The report can show the run against last month, last year and budget side by side without extra work.
lenses.altitude: The specialist defines matching rules and tolerances and reviews the exception log instead of doing the matching.
reach: Bookkeeper: bank reconciliation of the salary clearing account
Controller: payroll section of the month-close pack

tasks.human_edge: Judging why a payment came back or went out twice, and deciding whether to repay, recover or escalate.
tasks.pattern_why: Both sides are structured files and the match rules can be written down and tested; no model is needed to get the numbers right.

in_practice.trigger: Rabobank statement for the salary payment date is available
steps: Pull the AFAS pay run journal and the SEPA batch file
Import the Rabobank camt.053 statement
Match on IBAN, amount and end-to-end reference with set tolerances
Build the period report pack from the matched data
Send exceptions to payroll and the pack to the Controller
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist signs off the exception list and the pack before it goes into the month close
data_needed: AFAS pay run journal and payment file
in_practice.logs_to: Reconciliation log on SharePoint per pay period, linked to the month-close checklist

evidence.claim: Payroll reconciliations should be scored as deterministic software at autonomy 4-5, not LLM work
evidence.source: Research digest, 'For the model'; model knowledge

evidence.claim: Payroll calculation and checks stay deterministic and rules-based in production tools

risks: Matching on amount alone hides two offsetting errors
Statement format changes at the bank break the import silently
research_questions: How many lines per month fail to match today, and what are the causes?
Can AFAS export the SEPA end-to-end reference per employee so matching is exact?
How long does the Controller wait for the payroll pack today?

tasks.short: Run monthly and four-weekly payroll in AFAS, check it, release payslips and the Rabobank payment batch.

today.trigger: Payroll calendar: hours, mutations and absence closed for the period
steps: Check that mutations from HR and managers are entered in AFAS
Run the payroll calculation for both CAO groups
Compare totals and spot-check outliers in Excel against last period
Approve the run, publish payslips in AFAS InSite and create the payment batch
Answer the first wave of payslip questions by mail and Teams
drudgery: Eyeballing hundreds of payslips for odd amounts
today.time_sinks: Finding the few wrong payslips (missed shift allowance, stopped pension, leaver paid twice) before payment day

lenses.faster: Pre-run rule checks flag gross pay jumps, stopped pension, leavers paid, rates below minimum wage and CAO scale mismatches, so spot-checking disappears.
lenses.autonomous: Checks run on every trial calculation and a short note explains each flag; the specialist reviews only the flagged employees.
lenses.ambitious: First-time-right pay runs as a published measure, with corrections per run tracked and driven down.
lenses.joy: No more scanning payslips; the work becomes fixing causes so the same flag does not return.
lenses.options: For a late mutation the system shows: include now with re-run, pay as off-cycle, or correct next period, with the cost of each.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the check rules for both CAOs and flex arrangements and tunes them from false alarms.
reach: HR Administrator: answering payslip questions with a quoted calculation
Compensation and Benefits: checking pay against CAO scales

tasks.human_edge: Accountability for releasing pay and deciding on edge cases where the rule and the situation disagree.
tasks.pattern_why: Gross-to-net stays in AFAS; the checks are written rules, with a model only explaining each exception in plain words.

in_practice.trigger: Trial payroll calculation completed in AFAS
steps: Run rule checks on the trial results against prior period and CAO tables
Generate a short explanation per flagged employee
Specialist resolves flags and re-runs where needed
Specialist approves the run; payslips publish and the SEPA batch is created
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist approves each run and the payment batch (four-eyes with the Controller for the batch)
data_needed: CAO wage tables and allowance rules
in_practice.logs_to: Pay run check log per period with flags, resolution and approver

evidence.claim: Production checks flag unexpected gross pay moves, stopped pension, a leaver paid double and pay below minimum wage, while calculation stays rules-based
Workday's Payroll Agent will flag items outside defined parameters for payroll to check
Generated gross-to-net is unacceptable; almost right means someone is paid wrong

risks: Too many false flags and people stop reading them
Two CAOs and flex arrangements multiply rule variants that drift from AFAS setup
Employees distrust AI near pay: 46% uncomfortable in a US survey [S4]
research_questions: How many corrections per run do we make today, and which check would have caught each?
Can the checks run on an AFAS trial calculation via the API before approval?
What false-flag rate would the specialist accept?

tasks.short: Make monthly pay and benefit summaries for Finance, HR and management, and answer ad hoc data requests.

today.trigger: Month close, budget rounds and ad hoc requests from Controller, FP&A or HR Director
steps: Export pay components from AFAS to Excel
Group by site, cost centre, CAO and contract type
Add flex agency costs from invoices
Format and mail the summaries to each department
drudgery: Rebuilding the same pivots each month
Answering the same question for a different cost centre
today.time_sinks: One-off requests that need a new cut of the data

lenses.faster: Standard summaries come from Power BI on the nightly AFAS extract, with a short drafted commentary on the main movements.
lenses.autonomous: Reports refresh after the pay run closes and are sent to subscribers; requests not covered go to the specialist.
lenses.ambitious: Build the gender pay gap and equal-work averages that the pay transparency law will require, a year before the first report over 2027 pay is due in June 2028.
lenses.joy: No repeated pivots; time goes to explaining what moved and why.
lenses.options: Show labour cost scenarios for a CAO raise or a flex-to-permanent shift side by side.
lenses.altitude: The specialist defines the pay data model and definitions once and checks the commentary, rather than building each report.
reach: People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: pay dashboards
FP&A Analyst: labour cost forecast inputs
Compensation and Benefits: pay transparency reporting

tasks.human_edge: Knowing which numbers are sensitive, who may see them under GDPR, and what the movement actually means.
tasks.pattern_why: The data is structured and the definitions are fixed; a model may draft commentary, but the figures come from queries.

in_practice.trigger: Pay run closed and nightly AFAS extract refreshed
steps: Refresh Power BI pay datasets
Generate variance commentary on the main movements
Specialist checks numbers and commentary
Publish to the subscribers by role-based access
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist checks figures and commentary before distribution
data_needed: Job and grade data for pay transparency
in_practice.logs_to: Power BI refresh history and a distribution log on SharePoint

evidence.claim: With 1,200 staff Noordhaven must report the gender pay gap yearly, first over 2027 pay, due 7 June 2028; start date still set by royal decree
AFAS Profit 8 stores job schemes for pay transparency and shows wage-component history

risks: Pay data in wider dashboards breaches need-to-know under GDPR
Drafted commentary states a cause that is not true
research_questions: Which recurring reports could be retired once Power BI covers them?
Are job levels in AFAS clean enough for equal-work pay comparisons?
Has the works council been consulted on the job evaluation system it must consent to?

tasks.short: Keep the payroll ledger accounts (net wages, wage tax, pension, deductions) balanced and cleared each month.

steps: Pull balances of payroll clearing accounts from the AFAS general ledger
Compare with pay run totals, loonaangifte and pension invoices
Find and explain residual balances
Post or request correcting journals with the Accountant
drudgery: Rolling forward the same balance sheet in Excel
today.time_sinks: Old unexplained balances that grow over months

lenses.faster: A rule set compares each clearing account to its source (pay run, tax return, pension invoice, bank) and lists only the differences with likely cause.
lenses.autonomous: Runs at each month close and keeps an ageing list of open items that escalates after 60 days.
lenses.ambitious: Clearing accounts at zero every month, with no residue carried into the year-end audit.
lenses.joy: No more archaeology on old balances.
lenses.options: For each difference, propose the correcting journal options for the Accountant to choose.
lenses.altitude: The specialist defines which source belongs to which account and owns the tolerance rules.
reach: Accountant: payroll balance sheet reconciliations
Controller: audit file for payroll

tasks.human_edge: Deciding whether a difference is a timing issue, an error, or something to recover, and agreeing journals with Finance.
tasks.pattern_why: Balances and sources are structured numbers with known relationships; rules can be tested.

in_practice.trigger: Month close checklist reaches payroll accounts
steps: Pull ledger balances and the matching source totals
Compare per account and age open items
Propose correcting journals for differences
Accountant posts after specialist review
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist reviews differences; Accountant approves and posts journals
in_practice.logs_to: Balance sheet reconciliation file per month in the close folder

evidence.claim: Reconciliations belong to deterministic software at high autonomy

risks: Automated proposals posted without understanding cause
Mapping of accounts to sources goes stale after AFAS chart changes
research_questions: What residual balance sits on payroll clearing accounts today and how old is it?
Did the auditor raise payroll reconciliation points last year?
Can journal proposals be loaded into AFAS as drafts?

tasks.short: Correct earlier pay mistakes and process back pay, like a late CAO raise, and tell employees what changed.

today.trigger: Error reported by an employee or manager, or a CAO raise agreed with retroactive effect
steps: Collect the correction request from mail or Teams and check the facts
Enter the retroactive mutation in AFAS and let it recalculate
Check the outcome per employee, including tax and pension effects
Explain the correction to the employee
Make sure corrections flow into the next loonaangifte
drudgery: Reading through mail threads to find what was actually agreed
Writing the same explanation many times after a CAO raise
today.time_sinks: Back-and-forth to establish facts, and checking retro results for hundreds of employees after a CAO change

lenses.faster: A model reads the request and supporting mail into a structured correction; AFAS calculates; rules check the result against expected amounts.
lenses.autonomous: After a CAO raise, the retro run, the checks and the drafted notices are prepared ahead; the specialist approves.
lenses.ambitious: Every correction gets a root cause, so corrections per run fall instead of recurring.
lenses.joy: No more retyping the same explanation; the specialist handles the disputed cases.
lenses.options: For a large underpayment the system shows paying at once, in instalments, or in the next run, with tax effects.
lenses.altitude: The specialist designs the correction intake and the root cause log.
reach: HR Administrator: correction intake
HR Business Partner: explaining corrections to managers

tasks.human_edge: Deciding what is fair and lawful when recovering an overpayment, and talking to the employee when money is taken back.
tasks.pattern_why: Several steps and unstructured input, but money moves only after payroll approves; AFAS keeps doing the calculation.

in_practice.trigger: Correction request logged or retroactive CAO table loaded in AFAS
steps: Extract the correction into a structured form from the request
Prepare the AFAS mutation with retroactive date
Check calculated results against expected amounts and parameters
Draft the employee notice that quotes the calculation
Specialist approves mutation and notice
in_practice.human_gate: Payroll Specialist approves each correction and notice; recoveries above a threshold also go to HR Business Partner
in_practice.logs_to: Correction register with cause, amount, approver and notice sent

evidence.claim: Workday's Payroll Agent will audit retroactive adjustments and draft employee notices for payroll to check
Rule-based pay decisions still need a route to human review

risks: Misread request turns into a wrong mutation
Notices sound final when the employee can still dispute
research_questions: How many corrections per month, and what share are caused by late or wrong mutations?
How long did the last retroactive CAO raise take end to end?
Would the works council need to consent if requests are read by a model?

tasks.short: Check and send the monthly loonaangifte to the Belastingdienst and handle corrections and year-end.

steps: Let AFAS build the loonaangifte from the closed pay runs
Check totals against the payroll journal and prior months
Send via AFAS and check the receipt and any rejection messages
Pay the wage tax due and send correction returns where needed
today.time_sinks: Working out rejections and correction returns after retroactive changes

lenses.faster: The tie-out between return, journal and ledger runs as rules, so the specialist only reviews differences.
lenses.autonomous: The check runs once AFAS has built the return; when it is clean the specialist approves and sends in one step.
lenses.ambitious: Review werkkostenregeling usage and sector premium codes every year instead of only at year-end, catching costly errors early.
lenses.joy: Less manual tying out; more time on the tax questions that need thought.
lenses.options: For a found error, show a correction return now against correcting in the next period.
lenses.altitude: The specialist owns the tie-out rules and follows law changes with a copilot.
reach: Accountant: wage tax payable account
Controller: tax compliance file

tasks.human_edge: Liability for the filing and judgement on tax treatment questions.
tasks.pattern_why: The return is generated from pay data by AFAS; the checks are numeric ties; filing is legal and must not be generated by a model.

in_practice.trigger: AFAS has prepared the monthly loonaangifte
steps: Tie return totals to pay journal and ledger
Flag differences and new correction lines
Specialist reviews and sends
Log receipt and schedule the payment
in_practice.logs_to: Tax filing log with receipt and tie-out per period

evidence.claim: Filings belong to deterministic software at autonomy 4-5
AFAS Profit payroll prepares and sends the loonaangifte from pay data

risks: Over-trusting a clean tie-out that hides a wrong tax code
Law changes at 1 January not reflected in the rules
research_questions: How many rejections or correction returns did we have this year?
How long does the monthly tie-out take today?
Can law-change notes from AFAS be fed into a monthly review checklist?

tasks.short: Handle pension fund, UWV and insurer forms for joiners, leavers and sick staff, and check they match AFAS.

today.trigger: New starter, leaver, long-term sickness, or a letter or form from the pension fund, UWV or insurer
steps: Read the incoming letter or form
Check data against AFAS records
Fill in or correct the form or portal entry
Record outcome in AFAS and file the document
drudgery: Retyping data from AFAS into forms
today.time_sinks: Mismatches between fund records and AFAS that need back-and-forth

lenses.faster: A model reads incoming letters into structured fields, compares them with AFAS, and pre-fills the reply or form.
lenses.autonomous: Incoming mail is sorted and checked on arrival; matching items go to approval, mismatches to the specialist.
lenses.ambitious: A monthly match of pension fund enrolment against AFAS so nobody eligible is left out of pension.
lenses.joy: No retyping; work becomes solving real mismatches.
lenses.options: For a mismatch, show which side is likely wrong and what to send.
lenses.altitude: The specialist designs the intake fields and match rules.
reach: HR Administrator: joiner and leaver paperwork
Compensation and Benefits: pension administration

tasks.human_edge: Handling medical and sickness data carefully under GDPR, and deciding when to contact the fund or UWV.
tasks.pattern_why: Unstructured letters and forms become structured, checkable fields inside a fixed workflow.

in_practice.trigger: New document in the benefits mailbox or a joiner or leaver event in AFAS
steps: Classify the document and extract fields
Compare fields with AFAS
Pre-fill the reply or portal entry
Specialist approves and files
in_practice.logs_to: Benefits case log in AFAS with the document attached

evidence.claim: Production checks catch pension contributions stopped for someone still enrolled
A bot that reads the personnel file needs works council consent

risks: Sickness details processed beyond what GDPR allows the employer
Wrong extraction sent to the fund
research_questions: How many benefit documents arrive per month and of what types?
Does the pension fund offer a file or API to match enrolment?
What does the works council require before such intake goes live?

role.altitude: From running pay to owning the pay rules and checks: the specialist keeps CAO and flex rules explicit in AFAS, designs pre-run checks and tie-outs, and tracks first-time-right runs and corrections per run.
reach: Bookkeeper and Accountant: payroll clearing and bank reconciliations
HR Administrator: payslip questions and correction intake
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: pay transparency data and gender pay gap report
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: pay dashboards in Power BI
Bookkeeper: checking flex agency invoices against hours
role.ceiling_note: About 480 hours a year sit in these seven tasks; roughly half can go. The limits are legal liability for pay and filings, two CAOs plus flex rules, what AFAS exposes via its API, and works council consent for anything reading personnel data.
skills_to_grow: Writing pay rules and test cases
Power BI and AFAS data model
Pay transparency law and job levels
Checking model output and setting tolerances
role.ambitious_version: Zero-correction pay runs as a published HR measure, a payslip assistant that quotes the actual calculation (disclosed as AI), and a gender pay gap analysis ready a year before the first report in June 2028.
